LanguageData.HDA_NeckPlate.label: neck plate armor
LanguageData.HDA_NeckPlate.description: Overlapping solid plates of armor covering the neck.
LanguageData.HDA_HeavyNeckArmor.label: heavy neck armor
LanguageData.HDA_HeavyNeckArmor.description: Armor that firmly protects the neck. It is very heavy, so wearing it without a break leaves the shoulders stiff.
LanguageData.HDA_Heros_scarf.label: hero's scarf
LanguageData.HDA_Heros_scarf.description: The scarf a hero wears. The sight of one standing at the front encourages those who see it.
LanguageData.HDA_Masochists_Choker.label: masochist's choker
LanguageData.HDA_Masochists_Choker.description: A sturdy collar, also used as a restraint. Wearing it feels terribly humiliating.
LanguageData.HDA_RoseNecklace.label: rose necklace
LanguageData.HDA_RoseNecklace.description: A necklace shaped like a rose. When a man wears it, he comes to be liked by his own sex.
LanguageData.HDA_LilyNecklace.label: lily necklace
LanguageData.HDA_LilyNecklace.description: A necklace shaped like a lily. When a woman wears it, she comes to be liked by her own sex.
LanguageData.HDA_SwindlerNecklace.label: swindler's necklace
LanguageData.HDA_SwindlerNecklace.description: A con artist's necklace. The wearer feels healthy, and recovers from a bad back and stiff shoulders.
LanguageData.HDA_SunNecklace.label: sun necklace
LanguageData.HDA_SunNecklace.description: A necklace shaped like a sun. When worn, it lights the surroundings brightly.
